title: IHF GAD67+ NeuN Staining Protocol
author: Aroa S Maroto
materials: Bring the VECTASHIELD‱ HardSet‱ to room temperature

steps.title: Prepare Slices for Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Place one slice and citrate into each 2 ml tube, ensuring slices are completely submerged.

steps.title: Perform Heat-Induced Epitope Retrieval
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes in a thermoblock at 80ºC for 20 minutes (gentle shaking is optional).

steps.title: Transfer and Wash Slices
steps.instruction: Place approximately 3 slices per well on a multi-well plate and wash with 500 μl wash buffer (Wb) 3 times for 5 minutes each, ensuring all tissue is thoroughly covered.

steps.title: Block Tissue
steps.instruction: Add 500 μl/well of blocking Buffer and incubate for 2 hours at RT with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Apply First Primary Antibody (GAD67)
steps.instruction: Incubate slices with GAD67 primary antibody overnight at 4 °C with gentle shaking.

substeps.instruction: Prepare GAD67 primary antibody dilution 1/500 in antibody diluent
Add 500 μl/well of the prepared primary antibody to each well

steps.title: Wash After Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the slices with 500 μl/well Wb with shaking for 5 minutes; repeat this step at least 3 times.

steps.title: Apply First Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate slices with secondary antibody at RT with gentle shaking for 2 hours.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl/well of the secondary antibody to each well

steps.title: Wash After Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the slices with 500 μl/well Wb with shaking for 5 minutes; repeat this step at least 3 times.

steps.title: Apply Second Primary Antibody (NeuN)
steps.instruction: Incubate slices with NeuN primary antibody overnight at 4 °C with gentle shaking.

substeps.instruction: Prepare NeuN primary antibody dilution 1/1000 in antibody diluent
Add 500 μl/well of the primary antibody to each well

steps.title: Wash After Second Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the slices with 500 μl/well Wb with shaking for 5 minutes; repeat this step at least 3 times.

steps.title: Apply Second Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate slices with secondary antibody at RT with gentle shaking.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl/well of the secondary antibody to each well

steps.title: Wash After Second Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Wash the slices with 500 μl/well Wb with shaking for 5 minutes; repeat this step at least 3 times.

steps.title: Perform DAPI Staining
steps.instruction: Incubate slices with DAPI at RT with gentle shaking for 5 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl/well of DAPI to each well

steps.title: Final Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the slices with 500 μl/well Wb with shaking for 5 minutes; repeat this step at least 3 times.

steps.title: Mount and Seal Slices
steps.instruction: Mount the slices on slides and cover each slice with approximately 50 µl of VECTASHIELD HardSet.

substeps.instruction: Place the cover slide in a dark box and leave it to dry
